wiki_only_topics.topic: Population estimates by George Modelski and Ian Morris
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: According to George Modelski, Thebes had about 40,000 inhabitants in 2000 BC (compared to 60,000 in Memphis, the largest city in the world at the time). By 1800 BC, the population of Memphis was down to about 30,000, making Thebes the largest city in Egypt at the time.
